name: Montclair Place
description: Montclair Place is a premier enclosed regional shopping mall located in the heart of Montclair, California, offering a diverse mix of popular retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. The mall features a VIP rewards program that allows shoppers to follow their favorite stores and receive exclusive deals on sales and events. With convenient amenities including pet-friendly policies and a movie theater, Montclair Place serves as a complete shopping and entertainment destination for the Inland Empire community.
summary: Montclair Place is an enclosed regional shopping mall in Southern California's Inland Empire featuring extensive retail, dining, and entertainment options including a movie theater and VIP rewards program.
